battle.name: 唐朝與西突厥第二次戰役
battle.brief: 顯慶二年（657）正月，唐高宗以右屯衛大將軍蘇定方為伊麗道行軍大總管，率唐軍與回紇兵北擊西突厥沙鉢羅可汗賀魯。十二月唐軍進抵曳咥河西，一萬餘人破敵十萬，追奔至雙河與金牙山，西域遂平。卡上的羅馬重步兵非戰場實物，它標示的是「步兵據高、槊外向」的正面拒止。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 交戰雙方是唐王朝與西突厥汗國，回紇是唐的同盟出兵方，不是交戰方。唐廷以高宗李治的詔令發兵：右屯衛大將軍蘇定方出為伊麗道行軍大總管，燕然都護任雅相、副都護蕭嗣業、回紇婆潤為副總管，另以右武衛大將軍阿史那彌射與左屯衛大將軍阿史那步真為安撫大使，兵分西州、金城兩道北進；後方依託關內宿衛與十二軍府，糧秣由河西走廊與西域都護府接應，回紇僕從軍隨軍作戰並供應馬力。西突厥以沙鉢羅可汗賀魯為汗，國力來自十姓十部的聯軍與逐水草而居的游牧動員，營內分可汗牙帳、諸部俟斤與葉護，沒有固定城池與攻城器械，控弦之眾號稱十萬。西域諸小國如石國、鼠耨設地在兩強之間兩面應酬，靠詐降、閉門擒人與貢使往來求自保。兩套指揮系統也在戰場上並行：唐軍以鼓角旗幟傳令、以牙帳為帥府，西突厥則以牙帳與信騎往來聯絡各部。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Tang dynasty and the Western Turkic Khaganate; the Uyghur were allied auxiliaries of Tang, not a party to the war. On the Tang side the expedition was ordered by Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi. Su Dingfang, then commander of the Right Tunwei Guard, was made supreme commander of the Yili Route, with the Yanran Protector Ren Yaxiang, the deputy protector Xiao Siye and the Uyghur chieftain Porun as his deputies, while the Right Wuwei commander Ashina Yishe and the Left Tunwei commander Ashina Buzhen were appointed pacification envoys to move on the southern route. The army advanced by two columns, one through Xizhou and one through Jincheng; behind them stood the palace guard of the capital and the twelve army districts, with grain drawn from the Hexi Corridor and from the protectorates of the Western Regions, and the Uyghur auxiliaries marched with the host and supplied the horses. On the Western Turkic side the state rested with Shaaboluo Qaghan Helü, whose strength came from a confederation of the ten tribes and from pastoral mobilisation that followed the water and the grass. Its order was organised around the qaghan's tent, the begs of each tribe and the yabghus; it had no fixed cities and no siege engines, and its riders were said to number a hundred thousand. The small states of the Western Regions, the state of Shiguo and the town of Soghos among them, hovered between the two powers, buying survival with feigned surrenders, with gates closed on fugitives, and with a constant traffic of tribute and envoys. Two command systems ran side by side on that field: the Tang moved their orders by drum, horn and banner and made the commander's tent the seat of headquarters, while the West Turkic linked their divisions through the qaghan's tent and the galloping messenger.
people: 唐高宗李治是發動與拍板的人，詔令以伊麗道行軍大總管出征，軍還後詔令獻俘昭陵，並在戰後冊封西突厥內附王族。主將是蘇定方：前一年（656）他以左衛大將軍程知節前軍總管的身分，在陰山與牙山兩度擊破賀魯，卻被副大總管王文度以妒功矯詔收兵，無功而還；再征時他以右屯衛大將軍領大總管，把主動權拿了回來。程知節因逗遛不前被罷官，王文度因矯詔與擅殺降附被除名，總管蘇海政則在鷹娑川頂住突厥二萬騎。任雅相、蕭嗣業、回紇婆潤各領一翼作戰，蕭嗣業最後在石國受得賀魯。阿史那彌射與阿史那步真出南道策應，戰後受冊為興昔亡可汗與繼往絕可汗。沙鉢羅可汗賀魯本人兵敗被擒，解送洛陽前請求歸昭陵向先帝謝罪，高宗為之愍之，詔免其死。戰後蘇定方拜左驍衛大將軍、封邢國公，其子慶節封武邑縣公；同行的任雅相其後出為涪江道行軍大總管，龍朔年間病逝軍中。
peopleEn: Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi was the man who set the war in motion and who ratified it: he issued the order that named the supreme commander of the Yili Route, he ordered the captives paraded at the mausoleum of Taizong after the army returned, and after the victory he ennobled the West Turkic princes who had come over. The commander was Su Dingfang. A year earlier, in 656, he had fought as forward commander under Cheng Zhijie, left guard commander, and had beaten Helü twice, at Yinshan and at Yashan, only to see the expedition paralysed when the deputy supreme commander Wang Wendu, jealous of his credit, forged an order to halt the advance; the first expedition returned empty-handed. In the second campaign Su took the supreme command as Right Tunwei commander and recovered the initiative. Cheng Zhijie was stripped of his office for dawdling, Wang Wendu was cashiered for the forged order and the killing of those who had surrendered, and the commander Su Haizheng had held the line against twenty thousand Turkic riders at Yingsa River. Ren Yaxiang, Xiao Siye and the Uyghur Porun each led a wing of the host, and it was Xiao Siye who finally received Helü at Shiguo. Ashina Yishe and Ashina Buzhen moved on the southern route in support and were afterwards ennobled as the Qaghan of Xingxiwang and the Qaghan of Jiwang Jue. Shaaboluo Qaghan Helü himself was taken after his defeat, and on the road to Luoyang he asked to be taken to the mausoleum to make amends to the previous emperor; Gaozong pitied him and ordered that his life be spared. After the war Su was advanced to commander of the Left Xiaowei Guard and ennobled as Prince of Xing, his son Qingjie receiving the county of Wuyi; Ren Yaxiang, who had served as a deputy in the same campaign, was later sent out as supreme commander on the Hujiang route and died of illness in the field in the Longshuo years.
kits: 任務單上的羅馬重步兵（分段鎧甲配重盾）並非本役的實物，它在此標示的是「正面拒止」這一環：曳咥河畔唐軍的步兵正是靠披甲結陣、攢槊外向，硬擋住沙鉢羅的三次衝擊，才替北原的騎兵爭到反擊的時機。羅馬體系靠分段鎧甲與重盾，靠補充兵源與補給線維持戰力；唐軍沒有同樣的作坊與兵源，只能靠騎兵機動與就地徵發撐住遠征。唐軍裝備以長槊、陌刀、步弩與披甲騎兵為主，另有鼓吹、牙帳與鼓纛等旗幟儀仗；馬是決定性資源，656 年唐軍因終日披甲跨馬結陣而致馬匹瘦死，657 年則靠回紇僕從軍補馬力。西突厥裝備以輕騎、革弓、標槍與馬具為主，靠機動射擊取勝，全軍沒有攻城器械，最後攻破賀魯的牙帳靠的是奔襲突擊；石國沒有器械也沒有防線，只用一座城門與一場酒食的詐降就把人交了出去。
kitsEn: The Roman legionary on the card, a heavy infantryman in segmentary armour with a large shield, was never present in this campaign; here it stands for the one function that mattered most, the frontal refusal of the attack. At the Irtysh it was the Tang infantry, armoured, formed up in a solid block with their long spears levelled outward, that absorbed three charges by Shaaboluo's riders and so bought the time in which the cavalry on the northern plain could strike. A Roman army held its line with segmentary plate and the scutum, and kept itself going by the steady replacement of recruits and by its supply lines; the Tang had neither the workshops nor the reservoir of men, and could only sustain a distant campaign by horse mobility and by taking what the country gave. Tang kit was built around long spears, the miao dao, crossbows and armoured cavalry, together with the drums, the qaghan's tent and the captured standards that served as pageantry and as trophies. Horses were the decisive resource: in 656 the Tang army was kept mounted and armoured in formation so long that the horses were worked to death, and in 657 the Uyghur auxiliaries made up the shortfall. The West Turkic force was light cavalry with composite bows, javelins and saddle gear, winning by manoeuvre and shooting; it had no siege engines at all, and the kaghan's tent was taken by a sudden rush rather than by assault, while at Shiguo there was neither engine nor wall, only a gate and a banquet that turned into a cage.
tactics: 曳咥河之戰，賀魯見唐軍與回紇合計僅萬餘人，遂輕兵冒進、四面包圍。蘇定方的應法是把步兵置於南原高坡，攢槊外向成一堵拒止面，親領漢騎列陣北原；敵三次衝擊步陣不能入，騎兵趁其亂突出，敵遂大潰，追奔三十里。次日整兵復進，胡祿屋、五努失畢等部相繼歸降。追擊一段是全役最吃力的部分：蕭嗣業與回紇婆潤率蕃兵趨邪羅斯川追北，蘇定方與任雅相領新附之眾繼之；大雪平地二尺，軍中請停候晴，定方以「省日兼功在此舉」壓下異議，蹋雪晝夜兼行，至雙河與彌射、步真會師，距牙帳百餘里即長驅直入金牙山，掩其不備破其牙帳。全役的骨架是撫以為戰：新附部眾充當先鋒與追擊主力，戰後定方令諸部各歸所居，開通道路、置郵驛、掩埋骸骨、劃定疆場，把為賀魯掠走的人畜一併括還，十姓安堵如故。
tacticsEn: At the Irtysh, Helü saw that the Tang and the Uyghur together numbered barely more than ten thousand, and charged in, surrounding the much smaller force on all sides. Su Dingfang's answer was to plant the infantry on the rise to the south, spears levelled outward to make a refusing face, while he himself drew up the Han cavalry on the plain to the north. Three charges broke on the speared line without entering; the cavalry struck into the confusion of the enemy, who broke and were pursued for thirty li. On the next day the army re-formed and advanced again, and the tribes of Hulushe, of the Five Nushe and others came in and surrendered. The pursuit was the hardest part of the whole campaign. Xiao Siye and the Uyghur Porun were sent with the barbarian cavalry towards the Xieluosi River to cut off the north, while Su and Ren Yaxiang followed with the newly submitted people; the snow lay two chi deep on the level ground, the officers asked to halt until it cleared, and Su cut them short with the argument that saving days and doubling the labour lay in that very march. They pressed through the snow by day and night, joined Ashina Yishe and Ashina Buzhen at the Twin Rivers, and from a hundred li out went straight up to the Golden Tooth Mountain, catching the kaghan unprepared and breaking his tent. The skeleton of the whole operation was to fight by winning people over: the newly submitted tribes served as spearhead and as the main body of the pursuit, and afterwards Su sent each tribe back to its own ground, opened roads, set up relay stations, buried the dead, marked out the pastures, and returned the people and animals that Helü had carried off, so that the ten tribes might once more live in peace.
data: 656 年初征：鷹娑川（今新疆開都河上游裕勒都斯河谷）遇突厥二萬騎，總管蘇海政與之互有勝負；鼠尼施等率二萬餘騎來援，蘇定方以五百精騎馳擊，追奔二十里，殺一千五百餘人，獲馬二千匹，敵遺棄甲仗器械不可勝計；怛篤城一役降附胡人被屠。657 年再征：唐軍與回紇僕從軍共萬餘人，賀魯集十姓兵十萬；曳咥河三衝步陣不入，追奔三十里、斬首數萬級，斬大首領都搭達干等二百餘人；金牙山一役生擒數萬人，獲其鼓纛器械；處木昆屈律啜僅以數百騎西走；收其人畜前後四十餘萬；以其地置濛池、昆陵二都護府；大雪平地二尺（《冊府元龜》作三尺）；雙河距牙帳百餘里（《資治通鑑》作二百里）；顯慶三年十一月獻俘昭陵，詔免其死。《冊府元龜》稱其役「列其地為州縣，極於西海」；初征一役的唐軍損耗則無確數，只記軍還時士卒疲憊、馬多瘦死。
dataEn: The first campaign, in 656: at the Yingsa River, in the valley of the Yuldu River above the Kaidu in what is now Xinjiang, the Turkic fielded twenty thousand riders and the commander Su Haizheng traded blows with them without a decision; when the branch of the Ruminishi brought more than twenty thousand riders to the rescue, Su Dingfang took five hundred picked horsemen over a small ridge, pursued them for twenty li, killed more than fifteen hundred men, took two thousand horses, and the enemy left behind armour, weapons and harness in quantities nobody could count; at the city of Dadu those who had surrendered were killed. The second campaign, in 657: the Tang and the Uyghur auxiliaries together numbered a little over ten thousand, while Helü gathered a hundred thousand men of the ten tribes; three charges failed against the speared infantry at the Irtysh, the pursuit ran thirty li, and tens of thousands were killed, among them more than two hundred great chiefs such as Dudagan; at the Golden Tooth Mountain tens of thousands were taken alive and the drums, standards and other equipment of the camp were captured; only several hundred riders under Chumu Kun Lutuo escaped westwards; the herds and people recovered numbered more than four hundred thousand; two protectorates, Mengchi and Kunling, were established on the conquered ground; the snow lay two chi deep, though the CeFu Yuangui has it as three chi; the Twin Rivers stand a hundred li from the kaghan's tent, the Zizhi Tongjian says two hundred; in the eleventh month of the third year of Xianqing the captive was paraded at the mausoleum and his life was spared by decree. The CeFu Yuangui says of the campaign that the land was organised into prefectures and counties as far as the Western Sea; of the losses of the first expedition no exact figure survives, only the note that on the march back the men were worn out and many of the horses had been worked to death.
cause: 戰爭的根源在西域的歸屬之爭。西突厥內部分裂之後，賀魯殺其可汗自立，兼併諸部、雄據十姓，並不斷南向金山、伊麗一帶掠奪，斷絕唐通往西域的通道與牧場。唐廷自貞觀末年以來，以都護府、都督府與冊封可汗的方式羈縻西域，沙鉢羅既不願受唐的羈縻，又不容唐的使節、牧場與商旅插手於十姓之間，先前設立的安撫大使體制因而失效。656 年程知節征賀魯，因王文度矯詔收兵而無功而返，賀魯聲勢更盛，其後兩年不斷入寇，唐廷邊州與商旅受害。657 年唐廷趁西突厥內亂之機再啟戰端：詔以蘇定方統伊麗道兵北討，任雅相、蕭嗣業、回紇婆潤為副，阿史那彌射與阿史那步真出南道策應，另遣西州、金城兩道配給糧秣。目標很明確，是要拿掉賀魯本人，換回通道與牧場的安全，並把十姓重新編入唐的羈縻體系；唐廷的算盤是，賀魯一被擒，十姓便失去共主，其餘部落別無選擇，只能各自向唐請降。
causeEn: The root of the war lay in the contest for the ownership of the Western Regions. After the Western Turkic confederation split, Helü killed his own qaghan, seized the tribes and dominated the ten surnames, and pushed south toward Jinshan and the Ili, taking the Tang border prefectures and the caravan roads and cutting the empire off from its pastures and its road into the west. Since the end of the Zhenguan reign the Tang had controlled the Western Regions through protectorates, military governorships and the investiture of qaghans. Shaaboluo would accept no such discipline, and equally would not let Tang envoys, herds and merchants work between the ten tribes, so the pacification-envoy system established earlier had already failed. When Cheng Zhijie campaigned against Helü in 656 the expedition was stopped by Wang Wendu's forged order and returned with nothing, and Helü grew bolder, raiding again and again over the two years that followed, to the harm of the Tang border prefectures and the caravans. In 657 the court struck while the Western Turks were still divided: the order named Su Dingfang to command the Yili Route, made Ren Yaxiang, Xiao Siye and the Uyghur Porun his deputies, sent Ashina Yishe and Ashina Buzhen to support on the southern route, and laid out supply along the Xizhou and Jincheng roads. The object was plain enough: to remove Helü himself, to buy back the safety of the roads and the pastures, and to fold the ten tribes back into the Tang system of clientage. The court's calculation was plain: once Helü was taken the ten tribes would have lost their common lord, and the rest, having no choice left, could only come to the Tang and ask to surrender one by one.
impact: 此役之後，十姓悉歸唐境，唐以阿史那彌射與阿史那步真為兩大可汗，在其地置濛池、昆陵二都護府，設官分部、頒授刺史以下官職，天山南北重新納入唐的羈縻體系；金山道與伊麗道的商旅驛傳恢復暢通，西域的駿馬、玉器與雜貨沿河西走廊大批內運，北疆的畜群與兵源因此補充，唐廷得以在數年後的東北用兵中調用新附的西突厥與回紇兵。從軍事上看，657 役也讓唐廷看清北道用兵的極限：遠征靠騎兵機動與「所過收其部眾」式的就地徵發支撐，一旦遇上冬季雪原就極易失控，656 年王文度收兵與 657 年定方冒雪追擊恰是兩種處置的對照，前者前功盡棄，後者一舉成名。另一面，唐朝對西域的羈縻既靠冊封可汗又靠都護府，權力重疊留下日後唐與西突厥可汗、吐蕃之間反覆拉鋸的格局；同年唐廷轉向東北，蘇定方圍平壤不克而還，也說明西域的勝利並未換來全局的順利。
impactEn: After the campaign the ten tribes came over to Tang, and the court installed Ashina Yishe and Ashina Buzhen as the two great qaghans, set up the protectorates of Mengchi and Kunling on the conquered ground, allotted offices to each tribe and granted ranks from governor downward; the mountains north and south of the Tien Shan were drawn back into the Tang client system, and the caravan roads of Jinshan and the Ili reopened so that horses, jade and sundries moved east along the Hexi Corridor in bulk, replenishing the herds and the manpower of the northern frontier and giving the Tang access, in the fighting of the following years, to the newly submitted West Turkic and Uyghur troops. Strategically, the campaign of 657 also showed the court how far a northern expedition could be pushed: it rested on horse mobility and on taking what the country gave, the phrase in the record being that they collected the people's flocks as they passed, and once a winter plain opened up, control could easily be lost. The two courses of 656 and 657 form a clean contrast, Wang Wendu's halt throwing away the campaign and Su Dingfang's march through the snow winning it in one stroke. On the other hand, Tang control of the Western Regions rested both on investiture and on the protectorates, and that overlap of authority left the later pattern of repeated friction between the Tang, the West Turkic qaghans and Tibet. The same year the court turned east, where Su Dingfang's siege of Pyongyang failed and he had to withdraw, so that the victory in the west did not make the empire's position easy overall.
result: 唐軍完勝。曳咥河一戰破賀魯主力，追奔三十里、斬首數萬級；次日胡祿屋、五努失畢等部悉眾來降，處木昆屈律啜僅以數百騎西走；雙河會師後長驅金牙山，盡破其牙帳，生擒數萬人，賀魯與子咥運、婿閻啜脫走石國，終為鼠耨設城主伊涅達干以酒食詐誘就擒，蕭嗣業解送京師。五咄陸部落聞賀魯敗，南道降於阿史那步真。蘇定方令諸部各歸所居，開通道路、置郵驛、掩埋骸骨、劃定疆場，把為賀魯所掠的人畜悉數括還，十姓安堵如故。唐以其地置濛池、昆陵二都護府，分封彌射為興昔亡可汗、步真為繼往絕可汗；沙鉢羅可汗賀魯於顯慶三年十一月獻於昭陵，高宗詔免其死，蘇定方拜左驍衛大將軍、封邢國公，其子慶節封武邑縣公。安置諸部時，唐廷詔令盧承慶等按部落大小、位望高下節級除授刺史以下官，十姓自此有明確名號；昆陵、濛池二府與西突厥可汗並存，成為唐在北疆延續數十年的雙重架構。
resultEn: The Tang won outright. At the Irtysh they broke Helü's main body and pursued him for thirty li, killing tens of thousands; the next day the tribes of Hulushe and of the Five Nushe came over in a body, and only several hundred riders under Chumu Kun Lutuo got away west. After joining forces at the Twin Rivers the army drove straight to the Golden Tooth Mountain, broke the kaghan's tent, and took tens of thousands alive. Helü, his son Qidun and his son-in-law Yanzhui fled to Shiguo, where the commandant of Soghos, Yini Dagan, lured him with wine and food and shut the gate on him; Xiao Siye brought him back to the capital. The tribe of Wudu Lu, hearing of the defeat, came over to Ashina Buzhen on the southern route. Su Dingfang sent each tribe back to its own ground, opened the roads, set up relay stations, buried the dead, marked the pastures, and returned every person and animal that Helü had carried off, so that the ten tribes might once more live in peace. The Tang set up the protectorates of Mengchi and Kunling on that ground, invested Yishe as the Qaghan of Xingxiwang and Buzhen as the Qaghan of Jiwang Jue, and ranked the ten tribes by size and standing. Shaaboluo Qaghan Helü was paraded at the mausoleum of Taizong in the eleventh month of the third year of Xianqing and pardoned by order of the emperor; Su Dingfang was advanced to commander of the Left Xiaowei Guard and ennobled as Prince of Xing, and his son Qingjie received the county of Wuyi. For the settlement of the tribes the court ordered Lu Chengqing and others to assign ranks from governor downward according to the size and standing of each tribe, so that the ten surnames now had names on the record; the protectorates of Kunling and Mengchi and the West Turkic qaghans were to exist side by side, a dual structure in the northern frontier that lasted for decades.
